verdict.rationale: incident.io documents several in-product AI features built on your incident data. Suggestions automatically drafts updates, summaries and follow-up actions from incident activity. Investigations gathers context, forms hypotheses and tests them against code and telemetry to find root cause. Post-mortem AI generates drafts and inline review suggestions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality, and AI-driven analysis of aggregate or historical data (the Insights dashboard is documented only as standard reporting with no AI).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.

The moment an incident is declared, an investigation gathers context from across your stack: the alert and its stack trace, similar past incidents, incident channel discussion and change events, your runbooks, recent code changes, and your telemetry.
It's a structured process that gathers evidence, forms a hypothesis, then tests that hypothesis against your code and telemetry, refining its conclusion as new evidence arrives.
Generate first drafts, get inline review suggestions, and redraft sections with AI.
